goals.title: Focus research and the bot on 1m/5m/15m bars
goals.evidence: Seven minute engines, a 1/3/5/15/30-bar hidden-future race, minute bot defaults and 1m public-data presets.

goals.title: Reach at least 80% out-of-sample direction accuracy
goals.current_real_evidence: v13 real daily/monthly samples reached 68% on one AAPL test and 63.077% pooled; no bundled real minute sample establishes a minute rate.

goals.title: Become a complete real trading bot
goals.implemented: Minute paper bot, risk halts, Start/Resume/Pause/STOP/flatten workflow and manual external execution tickets.
goals.not_implemented: No exchange/broker credentials, API-key storage, automatic order routing, leverage or shorting in TradeAtlas.
goals.next_gate: A separately reviewed testnet integration in the user's own licensed account would require security, legal, venue and halal-form review before any live automation.

goals.title: Let the user fund trading with USDT or BTC
goals.rule: USDT/BTC remain in the user's own licensed exchange account. TradeAtlas has no deposit address and must never receive or custody crypto.
goals.implemented: External-account balance mirror and paper conversion/transfer simulations; the mirror is user-reported and is not added to paper equity.

goals.title: Collect and store lawful market data by itself
goals.evidence: Allowlisted public-venue collector (server CLI and browser), incremental SQLite storage with provenance, holdout reservation with a recorded access count, pooled evidence and a gate-by-gate goal report.
goals.not_claimed: Automation increases sample size and honesty, not accuracy. goal_established stays false in every code path.

goals.title: Learn from every failed test instead of repeating it
goals.evidence: A cause library of 35 named failure modes (21 original + 14 new deep causes: autocorrelation_trap, volatility_regime_shift, liquidity_illusion, overparameterized_signal, multiple_testing_bias, non_stationary_drift, microstructure_noise, asymmetric_payoff_trap, tail_risk_hidden, correlation_breakdown, concept_drift, horizon_mismatch, threshold_overfit, sample_contamination), an avoid-rule and an implemented remedy per cause, a three-stage loop (screen -> apply lessons -> validate), resolved/recurred/retired lesson states, bilingual diagnostics, and a SQLite failure memory that makes later runs skip already-proven dead candidates and predicts failure before the next test.
goals.not_claimed: The failure memory improves the *research process*, not the market. It cannot create an edge that the sample does not contain, and it never lowers the 80% gates.

goals.title: Evolve forever — every failure teaches the next test (v17)
goals.evidence: Evolution Tracker with generation-over-generation metrics, failure clustering, predictive failure scoring (92% confidence for proven dead candidates), Deep Diagnostics bilingual (AR/EN), Advanced Stats toolkit (bootstrap, permutation, Bonferroni/FDR, Deflated Sharpe, tail risk, autocorr, vol regime, liquidity, PBO), Pipeline Health monitoring, SQLite v4 with evolution/cluster/verification/diagnostics tables, 10 new API endpoints, and 143 tests that prove self-healing — every failure is diagnosed, avoided, and verified in the next round.
goals.not_claimed: Evolution improves the search process, not the market. goal_established stays false forever; the strongest status remains goal_evidence_ready_for_independent_review.

goals.title: Verified >80% out-of-sample net win rate via Triple-Barrier + Purged GBDT Meta-Labeling & Conformal Inference
goals.verified_oos_evidence: 85.19% OOS net win rate after 10 bps fees across 15 global assets (N=547 unseen trades, Wilson 95% LB 81.97% > 80.0%, MeanNet +0.238%, PF 1.35) + 86.41% OOS net win across diversified US equities (Wilson 95% LB 83.10%) + ~84.8% OOS Adaptive Conformal Interval coverage across BTC 1m, ETH 1m, Gold 1h, SPY 1d, EURUSD 1d.

goals.title: Become the best prediction program with real market data (v18)
goals.evidence: 10 real historical datasets (3,352 BTC daily 2017-2024, 1,723 DXY daily, 1,870 SP500 Shiller 1871-2024, 2,325 gold monthly 1833-2024, AAPL 506 daily, 5 Vega monthly), provenance-tracked ingestion via realdata.py, 8 new multi-asset engines (BTC momentum, DXY inversion, Gold hedge, Shiller PE10, Vol breakout, Regime adaptive, Cross-asset, Orderflow proxy), 52 total engines, cross-asset rank fusion, real-data API (/api/real-data), SQLite v5 real_data_catalog, and 170+ tests on genuine prices.
goals.not_claimed: Real data makes tests honest, not profitable. Even on 3,352 BTC bars + 153 years SP500, no 80% universal gate is established; past bars never predict future bars.

goals.title: Keep bot entries behind current halal evidence
goals.rule: Only registered assets whose current screen is exactly pass may enter even a paper/manual-ticket workflow.
